description: Digit Insurance (Go Digit General Insurance Limited, godigit.com) is an IRDAI-licensed digital-first insurer in India, positioned around simple online buying, paperless journeys, and app-led servicing. General insurance spans motor (car, bike, pay-as-you-drive, electric, own damage, third party), commercial vehicles (taxi, truck, auto/e-rickshaw, tractor, JCB, etc.), health (including cashless, super top-up, Arogya Sanjeevani, family floater, senior, portability, employee/group), travel (international, Schengen, multi-trip, student), home (Bharat Griha Raksha, home loan–linked), and business lines (workmen compensation, contractors all risk, plant and machinery, marine, D&O, professional liability, and related commercial covers). Digit Life offers term (e.g. Digit Glow family), savings, pension/retirement, and group life products. The brand emphasizes trusted scale (site: 7 Crore+ Indians), super-simple claims with smartphone self-inspection, cashless garage and hospital networks, renewals, and app-only utilities (e.g. challan check, credit score, PUC, VAHAN owner details, ABHA). Corporate narrative includes transparency reports and a large POSP/partner ecosystem.

differentiators: Strong digital and app-first positioning with paperless claims and self-inspection narrative
Broad general insurance portfolio plus separate Digit Life term and savings suite
Scale messaging (7 Crore+ customers) and partner/POSP ecosystem
Utility-led acquisition: challan, PUC, credit score, VAHAN, ABHA, calculators
Transparency reports and IRDAI-regulated disclosures (Reg. No. 158)
common_misconceptions: Digit General and Digit Life are distinct regulated entities; site surfaces both.
Pay-as-you-drive and promotional discounts are subject to product UINs and T&C on site.
